page_title: FIO 1-2 ROM | Fiorentina v AS Roma 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle as Moise Kean (Fiorentina) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+3' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+3' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma), but it's just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
90' The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
89' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the right side of the goal, but David de Gea shows his agility and makes a save.
86' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 17:20.

82' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
81' Substitution. Wesley Franca makes way for Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma).
81' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Matias Soule is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
81' Dodo (Fiorentina) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Niccolo Fortini.
80' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick.
79' Dodo (Fiorentina) is able to continue to play.
78' Dodo (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Matias Soule (AS Roma) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
75' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) replaces Pablo Mari.
75' Substitution. Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Rolando Mandragora walks off.
74' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the crossbar. Aim better, sir.
71' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
70' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

69' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
68' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' Here comes a substitution. Konstantinos Tsimikas is given a rest as he is replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
67' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) is being substituted because of an injury. Stefano Pioli sends Cher Ndour on the pitch.
66' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Yellow card. Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
63' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Moise Kean (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
61' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
59' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Tommaso Baldanzi and he is replaced by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
59' A substitution has been made. Artem Dovbyk is replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).

58' Dodo (Fiorentina) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
56' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

56' That's unlucky! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Fiorentina have a corner.
54' One of the players from Fiorentina times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

51' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Mile Svilar.
50' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Moise Kean (Fiorentina), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
47' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
47' Foul! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. A free kick to AS Roma.
46' That's the end of the game for Albert Gudmundsson, who is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Colombo had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Matias Soule (AS Roma) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
44' Stefano Pioli (Fiorentina) gets a yellow card.
43' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
42' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Andrea Colombo who sees an offensive foul.
38' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort low towards the middle of the goal and Mile Svilar easily makes the save.

37' What a great touch by Moise Kean (Fiorentina)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
37' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

36' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
35' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
35' PENALTY APPEAL after Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.

32' Dodo (Fiorentina) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.

30' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 1:2.
29' Now AS Roma have a corner.
29' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. AS Roma get a corner.
28' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
27' Matias Soule (AS Roma) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
26' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Wesley Franca (AS Roma) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
25' Dodo (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.

22' 1 - 1 Matias Soule (AS Roma) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the left post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:1.
21' The AS Roma players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
19' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
18' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

14' 1 - 0 Goal! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Mile Svilar had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
13' Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
11' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. AS Roma are awarded the free kick.
9' A spell of possession for Fiorentina in an attempt to control the game.
6' The foul by Manu Kone (AS Roma) was seen by Andrea Colombo who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

3' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends in a cross from the free-kick from the edge of the box. His effort is inaccurate and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
3' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
2' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick.
2' Manu Kone (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Andrea Colombo stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Fiorentina in a dangerous position.
1' AS Roma will kick the game off.
1' The first half has started.
Andrea Colombo got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
